evidence.title: Dynasty Decision Partner — Goodguy AI Labs

name: Dynasty Decision Partner
summary: Free prompt builder that turns dynasty fantasy football trade, roster and rookie-pick questions into prompts for an AI chat.
description: A free prompt builder for dynasty fantasy football. You pick the question (a trade offer, your rookie pick, a player you are buying, or a rebuild), share league details by link, pasted text or screenshots, and the page writes a prompt to copy into an AI chat. Ships with a master prompt, a league and roster template, a dynasty strategy guide and 14 example prompts.
contains: prompt builder for dynasty fantasy football questions
master prompt plus league and roster template
free, no signup on the page
